text:
morgan-partners: Quick heads up 1: EdgeCore (hardware SI) wants to publish their gateway to the marketplace. Listing checklist includes firmware notarization, SBOM, SOC2 pointer, and a redacted pen-test. Can we agree on package format + upload flow?

jake-security: High level yes. Minimum we ask for: SOC2 summary link, redacted pentest PDF (no customer data), CycloneDX SBOM, signed firmware blobs with auditor timestamp (RFC3161 or equivalent), and a signed chain-of-custody statement. Also need signer metadata (KMS/HSM id).

nina-eng: For the signed firmware: do we accept detached signatures (.sig) alongside the binary, or do you want an embedded signature? Marketplace prefers detached + RFC3161 timestamp for traceability.

rick-hw: EdgeCore here 1: we produce detached signatures and can request RFC3161 timestamps from TimestampX. We also have HSM attestation logs. We'll include PEM cert chain.

tomo-ps: Packaging preference: one gz archive per release named with vendor+version, plus a manifest.json at the repo root listing each file and its sha256. Include human-readable README.md with redaction notes and contact.

jake-security: Redaction rules: redact customer names, internal IPs, internal hostnames, and any PII. Keep vulnerability IDs, CVSS scores, and remediation status. Reviewer must sign-off on redaction before upload.

morgan-partners: Upload flow proposal: 1) partner requests presigned multipart upload for s3://redwood-partner-artifacts/<vendor>/<version>/attest.tar.gz 2) partner uploads parts directly 3) once upload completes, partner pings us with ETag + manifest hash 4) security verifies redacted pentest and signs final handoff. Target window: 10 business days.

nina-eng: Ops note: default presign TTL is 86400s (24h). For large archives we support multipart presign where we presign the create-multipart-upload and presign each part PUT. Example flow snippet:

```
# create multipart upload
aws s3api create-multipart-upload --bucket redwood-partner-artifacts --key edgecore/v1.2.3/attest.tar.gz
# returns UploadId
# then generate presigned URLs for part puts
aws s3 presign put-object --bucket redwood-partner-artifacts --key edgecore/v1.2.3/attest.tar.gz --expires-in 3600 --region us-west-2
```

(we can generate per-part presigns programmatically).

infra-bot: note: presign max TTL for partner bucket = 86400s. Long uploads require `presign-extension` tag and an ops approval request. Audit logs will capture uploader identity.

rick-hw: OK. We prefer 48h. If we need >24h for multipart that's fine if approved. Who files ops request?

morgan-partners: I can file the ops request once EdgeCore gives expected upload size. Nina, what's the approval criteria?

nina-eng: Ops approval if single-file size > 5GB or total > 20GB, or if presign > 86400s. Approval includes putting TTL and allowed source IP range.

jake-security: Also: manifest schema must include: vendor, version, release_timestamp, sha256 map, signer_cert_chain_pem, signature_files list, sbom_filename (cyclonedx.json), soc2_summary_url, pentest_redacted_filename, chain_of_custody_filename, hsm_attestation_reference. Add contact name & email and redaction_approver.

morgan-partners: Action items: - Rick/EdgeCore: assemble attest.tar.gz + manifest (owner: rick-hw) - Nina: confirm presign/multipart checklist & ops escalation path (owner: nina-eng) - Jake: redaction checklist + review slot (owner: jake-security) - Tomo: upload manifest template + sample README (owner: tomo-ps)

rick-hw: Starting today. ETA initial bundle by 1718612000. Will request presigns when ready.

jake-security: I'll reserve a 45-minute window next Tuesday for redaction review. Please tag me in the PR.

morgan-partners: One last Q: do we accept timestamping from third-party Notary vendors or only RFC3161 responses from our internal timestamping?

nina-eng: Third-party RFC3161 timestamps are acceptable if they provide a signed timestamp token and chain to a recognized CA. If using NotaryCorp, include the notarization receipt and signer cert chain.

infra-bot: ingest prefix: s3://redwood-partner-artifacts/edgecore/  presign-policy: max 86400s  audit: enabled.

tomo-ps: Uploaded manifest template to drive: https://drive.redwood/edgecore-manifest-template.json  Use `manifest-v2` schema.

morgan-partners: Thanks all. I'll coordinate ops request if Rick flags >20GB. :thumbsup:
